parameters.content:
### 1. Capture
Sample Goldcast-shaped webhook. Replace with a real Goldcast integration later.

### 2-3. Merge, Enrich & Synth
Supabase simulates the CRM. Bitscale does waterfall enrichment. Claude drafts the objection bullets.

### 4. Review Gate
Posts the interactive card. Button clicks are handled by the sibling workflow "Battlecard: Slack Action Handler".
